Aisha Morgan: Kicking off Cygnus onboarding — quick sync. 👋
Aisha Morgan: Stakeholders: Cygnus: Priya (PM), Jordan (Infra), External: Maria (ops). Redwood: Aisha (CS), Carlos (Solutions).
Carlos Rivera: Thanks — re: timeline, what's your target go-live?
Priya Desai: Want sandbox by 3/31, pilot w/ 2 teams 4/14, full rollout 5/12. Flexible if infra work runs long.
Aisha Morgan: Got it. I'll map milestones: sandbox (3/31), pilot start (4/14), pilot review (4/28), rollout (5/12).
Jordan Lee: Heads-up: we need SAML attributes for user_id and job_title. Our security team will only sign once SCIM is configured.
Aisha Morgan: Noted. Carlos — can infra team own SCIM + SAML config work? Estimate hours?
Carlos Rivera: I can own SCIM. Estimate 2 dev-days + 1 day with Redwood infra config. SAML handshake likely 1 day with customer SSO team.
Priya Desai: Risk: internal change freeze 4/10–4/20 — may affect pilot fixes.
Aisha Morgan: Good flag. We'll plan a quick canary before 4/10 and reserve 4/21–4/27 for hotfix window.
Aisha Morgan: Success criteria (proposed) — (1) 95% API success rate under pilot load, (2) end-to-end auth w/ SAML & SCIM, (3) <200ms 90th token latency for generation flows, (4) each pilot user completes enablement checklist. Thoughts?
Jordan Lee: Agree with 1–3. For latency, need baseline test against our sample prompts — I'll share artifacts.
Priya Desai: For enablement, can we do two 45-min sessions: dev integration + product ops walkthrough? Also want a 10-min exec summary for stakeholders.
Carlos Rivera: Yes. Carlos: I'll deliver an integration workshop recording and a config checklist.
Aisha Morgan: Capture items for the onboarding playbook: owners, deadlines, test plan, rollback steps, and feedback capture.
Aisha Morgan: Feedback capture — propose post-pilot survey + embedded quick ratings in the console for first 2 weeks. Priya, ok?
Priya Desai: Strong yes. Add a weekly 30-min check-in cadence during pilot.
Aisha Morgan: Scheduling: I'll send invites for weekly check-ins starting 4/7.
Carlos Rivera: Question on data ingestion — will Cygnus push historical docs or live sync only?
Priya Desai: Both. We'll do a bulk import (CSV + S3) then enable live sync. Bulk import likely 4/1–4/3.
Aisha Morgan: Action log (quick):
- Aisha: calendar invites + pilot success dashboard (by 3/25)
- Carlos: SCIM integration + workshop materials (by 3/28)
- Jordan: SAML attributes and baseline perf scripts (by 3/27)
- Priya: confirm SSO freeze windows and provide sample data (by 3/24)
Aisha Morgan: Renewal risk note: Cygnus is mid-contract and expects measurable value within 90 days. If pilot shows high latency or auth blockers, renewal could be at risk. We need to prioritize test coverage and QoS SLAs in the pilot.
Priya Desai: Acknowledged — we'll prioritize user flows that show business value (search + summarization).
Carlos Rivera: I'll add QoS alerts to our dashboards and set an SLO watch for token latency.
Aisha Morgan: Next steps: I'll drop a 1-pager with milestones & owners to this thread and ask for sign-off. Please react with :thumbsup: when you approve.
onboarding-bot: Reminder: onboarding checklist created — https://redwood.example.com/onboarding/cygnus — items synced to calendar.
Priya Desai: :thumbsup:
Jordan Lee: :thumbsup:
Carlos Rivera: :thumbsup:
Aisha Morgan: Great — thanks team. I'll post the 1-pager in 30m and lock invites after approvals.
